vc_sentences: E08 and Report Matrix: an employee who left during the accrual year is excluded from the deposit and is paid directly in the final settlement (Ley 50 de 1990 art. 99 num. 4), replacing the 'owed a pro rata deposit' sentence; the client's 10 Q4-2025 leavers are evidenced as paid directly via WT 62110/62117 with no WT 25827 deposit.

T03: the client's Master Data holds no document-type column, only four identity-number columns (14 employees with more than one filled, 2 with none); Employee.Document_Type is a separate master-data attribute and the column-to-code mapping is queried to RA.

T09: the client's Master Data holds only a fund NAME ('Severance Fund Name'), no 2-digit operator code, so a name-to-code table is required; the fund is blank for 63 of 263 employees, including 12 who received a February-2026 deposit (WT 25827).

T10: the exclusion of unpaid leave and suspensions (Population Rules Step 1) is added to the explanation; the client's counter WT 68029 is named as a reconciliation check only (68028 = 68040 x 68029 / 360 for 204 of 284 employees; 0 days for a deposited December hire; 300 vs 321 days against the client's own interest calculation).

T12: the client source is WT 63807 'Basic Salary Base Amount' in the December period (contractual monthly salary), not WT 62100 'Ordinary Salary' (amount actually paid, prorated); 63807 = 62100 for 190 of 286 employees and higher for 96, never lower.

T14: the value deposited is the consolidated 31 December balance net of the direct payments already made to the employee (CST art. 254 in-year partial payments; Ley 50 de 1990 art. 99 num. 4 for an employee who left before the deposit), evidenced by WT 25827 + WT 62126 = |WT 63814| for 280 of 282 employees; the treatment of a January partial payment to an employee still in service stays an RA query.

T15: the client's residential address is 'Address Line 1' (261 of 263 filled) plus 'Address Line 2' (159 of 263), concatenated before the 50-position rule; 6 employees have a non-CO 'Country' and 2 a lower-case 'co', so the treatment of a residence abroad is queried to RA.

T16: the client's 'Employee Address - Department' holds 3-letter abbreviations (18 distinct values, 3 blanks, including non-Colombian ON, VD, JAL), not the 2-digit DANE code; a coded master-data field or an abbreviation-to-DANE table is required.

T17: the client's 'City' is free text (60 distinct values with spelling variants, neighbourhoods, a department and foreign cities), no DANE municipality code; the divipola municipality code must be captured as a coded master-data field.

T18: the client's 'Phone number' is one untyped column (12 digits for 237 of 263; only 1 value has 7 digits; 9 blanks), so the field is zero-filled unless a separate landline is captured and is never derived by truncation.

T20: the client source is Master Data 'Hire Date' (DD-MM-YYYY, converted to AAAA-MM-DD), not 'Adjusted Service Date' (a seniority date) nor 'Original Hire Date'; the three dates differ for 21 and 40 of 261 employees respectively.

IN01: the client source for the consolidated 31 December balance is |WT 63814| in the January period (= WT 25827 + WT 62126 for 280 of 282 employees; WT 68028 December matches it for 238 of 285); WT 64999 is not this balance.

IN02: the client source is WT 62127 'Advance Interest Severance Pay' paid in January (284 employees; 281 equal round(12% x IN01 x days / 360)); WT 63815 at December is not the payable amount (differs for 104 employees).

E92: the flag covers a FULL discharge by proven direct payment only; an employee who left and was paid directly is a Population Rules Step 0 exclusion (Ley 50 de 1990 art. 99 num. 4), and a partial direct payment does not set E92 = Y - it reduces T14 and the record is still produced; the January payment to an employee still in service stays an RA query.
23 section-header and separator cells stored as formulas (rendered as #NAME? in Excel) converted to plain text in: Consignacion Cesantias Spec, Sample File. No content change.
